title.zh: Tether's Bitcoin Mining Development Kit Gains Backing from 15 Mining Companies t
title.en: Tether's Bitcoin Mining Development Kit Gains Backing from 15 Mining Companies t

current_state.zh: Tether released version 0.11 of its open-source Bitcoin Mining Development Kit at Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano, with 15 mining companies, ASIC manufacturers, and pools—including Bitmain, Bitdeer, Canaan, MicroBT, Foundry, F2Pool, Luxor, and Block's Proto—committing to support and integrate the unified open interface ahead of a targeted stable 1.0 release by end-2026.
